subtitle.en: A handful of desktop wallpapers adapted from the earlier poster concepts.
subtitle.zh: 几张由早先那些海报方案改编而成的桌面壁纸。

translator.note: 原文没有小标题；正文中的 7 张插图按源顺序逐张收录为占位段落。原文未夹带页面部件，无需剔除。

blocks.en: Since a lot of you have been asking for them, I put together a few wallpapers based on those poster ideas from a while ago (most of which were created by Luis, who has a great eye for composition. Hopefully I didn't butcher them too badly.)
blocks.zh: 因为很多人来问，我就基于前阵子那些海报方案做了几张壁纸（其中大部分是 Luis 创作的，他对构图很有眼光。希望我没把它们糟蹋得太狠。）

blocks.en: My hope is that at some point we will add a media section where we can put more wallpapers, posters, screenshots and such.  We are all working hard to finish the game, however, so it's not exactly a high priority.
blocks.zh: 我希望将来某个时候我们能加一个媒体区，用来放更多的壁纸、海报、截图之类的。不过我们大家都在拼命把游戏做完，所以这事优先级并不算高。
